decision.summary: No confirmed temporary offset intervals: both candidate segments (490–549 and 550–600) lack an observed opposing return within allowed context [455,699]. The E-rise/N-decline is coherent but monotonic or slowly evolving; the 'platform' is not a stable offset but a reduced-slope phase without reversal. U shows no coupled step. All proposed intervals remain uncertain due to missing return evidence.

intervals.observation: E rises monotonically from ~490 to 549; N declines steadily over same span. No opposing return observed before 550; interior shows coherent opposite-signed drift without plateau stabilization in raw data (plateau claim appears smoothed/interpreted). U noisy, no coupling.

Apparent platform 550–600: E flattens after rise, N continues slow decline but with reduced slope; however, neither axis shows a clear reversal or return toward pre-490 levels. Sustained offset persists beyond 600; no opposing return observed within allowed context (≤699). U remains uncorrelated and noisy.
